title.en: Exempting Foreign Tourists and Travelers From the Payment of Hotel Room Tax for the Duration of Their Stay in the Philippines
title.orig: Exempting Foreign Tourists and Travelers From the Payment of Hotel Room Tax for the Duration of Their Stay in the Philippines

text.en:
Foreign tourists and travellers shall be exempt from the payment of any and all hotel room tax
for the entire period of their stay in the country.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of October, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
